title: Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer - Germany
description: Your mission Servus und hallo bei uns in Sungrow! Join our Munich IT team and help keep the infrastructure behind Europe’s clean-energy growth secure, reliable, and ready for what comes next. Curious what this is all about? Let’s dive right in: Own the daily operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Sungrow Europe’s data center infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, and virtualization platforms. Manage and optimize enterprise network services across European locations, including routing, resilience, performance, capacity, and high-availability design. Take dedicated responsibility for Munich office connectivity, including switches, Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPNs, internet services, and meeting-room networks. Lead technical troubleshooting, incident response, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for complex infrastructure issues. Support modernization, expansion, migration, disaster recovery, and technology-refresh initiatives across infrastructure platforms. Strengthen security, compliance, and operational excellence through robust documentation, change management, vulnerability remediation, SOPs, and runbooks. Your profile All right, that was intriguing, wasn’t it? To thrive in this role and enjoy building reliable services for the long term, your background could look like this: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, along with at least three years of relevant infrastructure or enterprise network engineering experience. You bring hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls, SD-WAN, Cisco Firepower FTD, Cisco Nexus 9000, and Cisco enterprise switching environments. You have strong knowledge of routing, switching, and security technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VRF, ACLs, QoS, STP, NAT, link aggregation, and high-availability architectures. You are comfortable operating VMware, Nutanix, and KVM-based virtualization platforms, with knowledge of VMware NSX-T and its security capabilities. You have worked with monitoring and observability tools such as Zabbix, Prometheus, and Grafana, and can use Python, Shell, PowerShell, or Perl for automation. You combine structured problem-solving with a proactive mindset for capacity planning, service improvements, documentation, implementation plans, and rollback procedures. You communicate confidently in English at C1 level; German at B2 level is an advantage, and Mandarin Chinese at B2 level or above is a strong advantage for collaboration with global technical teams. Certifications such as VMware VCP, CCNA or CCNP, Microsoft Azure Administrator, ITIL Foundation, Fortinet NSE, or Nutanix Certified Professional are welcome. Why us? Join a collaborative IT department where your work directly supports Sungrow Europe’s growth and operational resilience. You will have real ownership of a diverse infrastructure landscape, work closely with international technical teams, and contribute to the systems that enable colleagues across Europe to stay connected, productive, and secure. At Sungrow, you will help modernize enterprise infrastructure in a fast-moving greentech environment, while building practical solutions across data centers, networks, cloud platforms, and workplace technology. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Wir suchen einen (Junior) SEO & AI Marketing Manager, der*die mit analytischem Scharfsinn und technologischer Neugier unsere Sichtbarkeit aufs nächste Level hebt. Du verstehst modernes SEO nicht als statische Optimierung, sondern als dynamisches Ökosystem, das du durch automatisierte Workflows und KI aktiv skalierst. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Optimierung unseres Contents für Generative Engine Optimization und Answer Engine Optimization, um in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) maximale Präsenz zu erzielen.

  • Website-Hygiene & Monitoring: Aufsetzen und Überprüfen automatisierter Sanity-Checks und technischer Crawls (z.B. mit Screaming Frog) sowie das direkte Ableiten operativer Maßnahmen.

Als unser/e E-Commerce Product Owner:in bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt/Dev , Operations und Marketing. Du baust Features, die Kunden weiterbringen und die Conversion messbar heben – und machst unseren Shop damit zum Maßstab in seiner Klasse. Deine Mission Full Ownership & UX/UI-Exzellenz: Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Webshop. Du ownsed die Produkt-Roadmap, steuerst die Features nach Business-Impact und sorgst für ein nahtloses, kundenfreundliches UI/UX-Erlebnis auf allen Devices. Conversion- & Journey-Optimierung: Du drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben über den gesamten Funnel hinweg, von der Suche über die PDP (Product Detail Page) bis zum Checkout. Data-Driven Growth: GA4, BI und A/B-Tests sind deine Spielwiese. Du übernimmst die KPI-Verantwortung (CVR, AOV, Warenkorbabbrüche, RPV) und leitest daraus konkrete Hypothesen und Experimente ab. Smart Features & Ökosysteme: Du entwickelst kundenfreundliche Kompatibilitäts-Filter (Matter, Apple Home, Alexa etc.) sowie intelligente Starter-Set- und Bundle-Mechaniken, die Erklärungsbedarf reduzieren und den Warenkorbwert steigern. Next-Level AI-Shopping: Du verantwortest innovative KI-Features - von Guided Selling über semantische Suchen bis hin zum Conversational Smart-Home-Assistant. Agile Schnittstelle: Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher. Dein Profil E-Commerce DNA: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im transaktionalen E-Commerce mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen bei der CVR- und Funnel-Optimierung (Du lieferst Kennzahlen, nicht nur Features!). Deep Tech- & Analytics-Verständnis: Sicheres Händchen für Web-Analytics (GA4, Tracking-Konzepte, Dashboards), Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie fundiertes Verständnis von modernen E-Commerce-Architekturen (Shopware, Magento, commercetools oder Headless/APIs). Kommerzieller Drive: Du denkst in Deckungsbeiträgen sowie Unit Economics und priorisierst Feature-Requests knallhart nach P&L-Impact. UX/UI & Qualitätssinn: Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen. AI-First Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben. Sprachkenntnisse : Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hervorragende Englischkenntnisse. Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten. Nice-to-haves: Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte (Consumer Electronics, Technik oder Smart Home). Verständnis für Smart-Home-Standards und Plattform-Ökosysteme. Gespür für Merchandising, Pricing-Schnittstellen und Margenlogik bei Sets/Bundles. Warum wir? tink Kultur tink Mission : Wir verbinden ein erfolgreiches Geschäftsmodell mit der Mission, allen Haushalten einen Zugang zu einem nachhaltigeren und smarten Zuhause zu ermöglichen. Expertise : Ein erfahrenes Management-Team mit langjährigem Hintergrund im Startup-, Industrie- und Beratungsgeschäft International : Unser Team kommt aus über 30 verschiedenen Nationen Diversität : Wir freuen uns über Bewerber:innen jeglicher Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, religiöser Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung und jeglichen Geschlechts. Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit und Performance. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung : Regelmäßige Feedback Runden und Reviews - Deine professionelle und persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen! Faire Kommunikation : Wir haben eine offene und transparente Feedback-Kultur. Office Policy : Wir sind ein Presence-first Team und arbeiten gemeinsam im Büro tink Benefits Remote Option: Du hast die Option auf bis zu 4 Wochen Remote Work pro Jahr Freizeit: Bis zu 30 Urlaubstage (nach Betriebszugehörigkeit) Gehalt: Wir zahlen leistungsgerecht und fair Start your day right: Wir haben eine top Kaffeemaschine, Müsli und frisches Obst Fitness: Bleibe fit mit dem bezuschussten Urban Sports Club Membership Shopping: Erfülle Dir einen Wunsch mit monatlichem SpendIt Card Budget Fun: Regelmäßige Teamevents & eine stets gut bestückte Bar Office: Ein wunderschönes helles Office direkt im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte am Hackeschen Markt mit vielen Meeting Räumen, Küche, Snacks, Getränken, Lounge-Area und umgeben von vielen Restaurants und Cafés Visa-Support: Wir unterstützen Kandidat:innen im kompletten Visa-Prozess Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Automation Engineer (gn) - 40 Std, (hybrid) (München)
description: Deine Aufgaben ​ Wir arbeiten über ein zertifiziertes Netzwerk lokaler Handwerkspartner – ohne eigene Installationskapazitäten. Der Erfolg unseres Geschäftsmodells hängt direkt davon ab, wie gut wir dieses Partnernetzwerk aufbauen , auslasten und kommerziell steuern . Für diese zentrale Rolle suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit , die unser Partnership Team leitet und gleichzeitig operativ in wichtige Verhandlungen mit Handwerkspartnern, OEMs und Großhandel eingebunden ist. Das Partnership Management ist eine Kernfunktion bei 42watt – zu deinen Aufgaben gehören: Du treibst den deutschlandweiten Ausbau unseres Handwerkspartner-Netzwerks voran, gewinnst neue und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und schaffst damit die notwendigen Kapazitäten für das weitere Wachstum von 42watt. Du verhandelst Preise, Projektvolumina, Kapazitäten und Rahmenbedingungen mit unseren Handwerkspartnern und stellst wirtschaftlich attraktive und langfristig erfolgreiche Partnerschaften sicher. Du denkst Partnerschaften strategisch und kommerziell und entwickelst Incentivierungsmodelle, Partnerstufen und Prozesse , die Wachstum und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg für beide Seiten fördern. Du verantwortest das Tendering unserer Projekte an das Partnernetzwerk und trägst damit maßgeblich zur Realisierung unseres kommerziellen Erfolgs bei (Revenue Operations). Du bindest OEMs und Großhandel strategisch in unser Partner-Ökosystem ein und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Konditionen für 42watt und unsere Handwerkspartner. Du entwickelst unser Partnernetzwerk datengetrieben weiter und steuerst es entlang von Kapazitätsbedarfen, regionaler Abdeckung, Auslastung sowie der Segmentierung und Entwicklung einzelner Partner. Du entwickelst die relevanten KPIs und Steuerungsmechanismen , um Performance, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit unseres Partnernetzwerks transparent zu machen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du führst und entwickelst unser Partnerships-Team , setzt klare Ziele und schaffst die Strukturen, mit denen das Team und unser Partnernetzwerk gemeinsam mit 42watt skalieren . Dein Profil Erfahrung im Partner-/Account-Management: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Partner- oder Account-Management mit (operativer oder Einkaufs-Schwerpunkt), idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld. Verhandlungsstärke: Du bist ein exzellenter Verhandler und hast nachweislich erfolgreich Preis-, Volumen-, Kapazitäts- und Rahmenvertragsverhandlungen geführt. Kommerzielles Denken: Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge hinter einem Partnernetzwerk und steuerst konsequent entlang von Umsatz, Marge, Kapazität und Auslastung. Strategische Netzwerksteuerung: Du kannst ein wachsendes Partnernetzwerk strukturiert weiterentwickeln, Kapazitätsbedarfe frühzeitig erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für Akquise, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Partnern ableiten. Datengetriebene Steuerung: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, leitest aus Daten konkrete Handlungsfelder ab und nutzt sie, um Performance und Wirtschaftlichkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Unser Mandant entwickelt moderne digitale Lösungen, die von namhaften Kunden aus unterschiedlichen Branchen genutzt werden. Das Unternehmen verbindet technologische Exzellenz mit einer offenen, entwicklerfreundlichen Unternehmenskultur und legt großen Wert auf nachhaltige Softwarearchitekturen, moderne Entwicklungsprozesse und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung seiner Teams.

Hier erwartet Sie kein Umfeld, in dem Features „einfach nur ausgeliefert“ werden. Stattdessen arbeiten Sie gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Software Engineers, Product Ownern und UX-Experten an hochwertigen mobilen Anwendungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen und von Beginn an technisch durchdacht werden.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung nativer iOS-Applikationen mit Fokus auf Performance, Stabilität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit
  • Konzeption und Implementierung moderner Softwarearchitekturen sowie technischer Lösungen für komplexe fachliche Anforderungen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, UX/UI Design und Backend-Teams innerhalb agiler Entwicklungsprozesse
  • Durchführung von Code Reviews sowie aktive Mitgestaltung von Best Practices, Coding Standards und Entwicklungsrichtlinien
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungspotenzialen hinsichtlich Codequalität, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit der Anwendungen


Ihr Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der nativen iOS-Entwicklung mit Swift sowie fundiertes Verständnis moderner iOS-Technologien
  • Erfahrung mit Softwarearchitekturen wie MVVM, Clean Architecture oder vergleichbaren Konzepten
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit REST-APIs, Git sowie gängigen CI/CD-Prozessen
  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch an sauberen, wartbaren und testbaren Code
  • Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Eigenverantwortung und Freude daran, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten


Benefits

  • Technologischer Gestaltungsspielraum: Ihre Ideen und technischen Entscheidungen finden Gehör und können direkten Einfluss auf Produkte und Prozesse nehmen.
  • Moderne Entwicklungsumgebung: Aktuelle Technologien, professionelle Toollandschaft und ein hoher Stellenwert für Softwarequalität.
  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine gelebte Vertrauenskultur.
  • Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Fortbildungsangebote, Wissensaustausch im Team und Unterstützung bei Ihrer persönlichen Karriereentwicklung.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Ein Umfeld, in dem pragmatisch gehandelt wird und Innovation nicht an unnötiger Bürokratie scheitert.
  • Kollegiales Entwicklerumfeld: Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe mit erfahrenen Engineers, die Technologie als Handwerk verstehen und voneinander lernen möchten.
  • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung sowie weitere Zusatzleistungen für Mitarbeitende.


Kontakt

Als spezialisierter Recruiting-Partner begleiten wir den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess persönlich und transparent. Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, hochwertige mobile Anwendungen zu entwickeln, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das gute Softwareentwicklung wertschätzt, freuen wir uns auf den Austausch mit Ihnen.

title: Grafikdesigner – Social Ads / Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Bevor du weiterliest: Diese Stelle ist bewusst nicht für alle geschrieben. Bei uns hast du sehr viel Freiheit. Wir kontrollieren nicht, wann du wie arbeitest, sondern was am Ende rauskommt. Diese Freiheit bekommst du aber nur mit Verantwortung: für deine Projekte, für deine Deadlines und für die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden. Teamwork steht bei uns an erster Stelle. Wir helfen uns gegenseitig, springen füreinander ein und liefern gemeinsam richtig geile Arbeit ab. Das funktioniert nur, wenn alle mitziehen. Wer das nicht tut, mit dem trennen wir uns konsequent, spätestens in der Probezeit. Das ist nicht böse gemeint, wir schulden es dem Rest des Teams. Wenn du einen gemütlichen Job suchst, spar dir und uns die Zeit. Bewirb dich nur, wenn du glaubst, dass du unser Team wirklich ergänzt, und die Ambitionen mitbringst, zu den Besten zu gehören. Wir sind ein Office-First-Team im Herzen Münchens und setzen auf enge Zusammenarbeit, starke Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Lieferqualität ohne Kompromisse. Lies die Ausschreibung bitte bis zum Ende, das ist schon Teil der Bewerbung. Du denkst in Hooks, nicht nur in Moodboards. Du weißt, dass eine Static Ad in unter zwei Sekunden entscheidet, ob jemand stoppt oder weiterscrollt, und genau dafür gestaltest du. In unserem Grafik-Team entwickelst du Statics, Carousels und ganze Ad-Serien für E-Commerce und DTC Brands auf Meta, TikTok und Google. Die sollen nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern messbar verkaufen. Du arbeitest eng mit Creative Strategy und dem Performance-Team zusammen, siehst die Zahlen deiner Creatives und nutzt sie, um das nächste Creative noch besser zu machen. Konkret Du gestaltest Static Ads, Carousels und Ad-Varianten für Meta (Feed, Story, Reels), TikTok und Google auf Basis unserer Creative Briefings. Du übersetzt Hooks, Angles und Offers in Layouts, die im Feed sofort funktionieren: klare Hierarchie, auf dem Handy lesbar, Produkt im Fokus. Du baust schnell und sauber Iterationen von Winner-Ads: neue Hooks, Formate, Visuals, Farbwelten. Du arbeitest innerhalb der Brand Guidelines und weißt, wann du sie im Sinne der Performance dehnen kannst. Du arbeitest eng mit Motion und Video zusammen und lieferst Dateien, die direkt animiert werden können. Du setzt KI-Tools (z. B. Firefly, Generative Fill, Midjourney) gezielt für Compositing, Freisteller und Szenen ein, ohne dass das Ergebnis nach KI aussieht. Du organisierst deine Projekte selbstständig und lieferst zuverlässig pünktlich. Dein Profil Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Grafikdesigner, davon nachweislich mit Social Ads oder Performance Creatives (Agentur oder In-house bei einer E-Commerce Brand). Sicher in Photoshop, Illustrator und Figma. Ein starkes Portfolio mit echten, live geschalteten Ads. Reine Branding-, Print- oder Uni-Projekte reichen für diese Rolle nicht. Sehr gutes Gespür für Typografie, Layout, Farbe und Bildbearbeitung (Retusche, Compositing, Freisteller). Du kennst die Ad-Formate (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) und Safe Zones und weißt, wie ein Static im Feed wirken muss. Du weißt, was CTR, Hook Rate und ROAS bedeuten, und willst verstehen, warum ein Creative gewinnt. Du arbeitest schnell und bleibst trotzdem pixelgenau, auch bei der 20. Variante. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (in Wort und Schrift). Lebensmittelpunkt München (unverzichtbar). Wir setzen auf Office-First. Diese Rolle ist NICHT für dich, wenn: Du um Punkt 18:00 Uhr den Laptop zuklappst. Du Ads für die kleine Schwester von „echtem“ Design hältst. Du an deinem Design festhältst, obwohl die Zahlen etwas anderes sagen. Du für jede Variante erst eine Woche Inspiration brauchst. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn: Du Ads im Feed nicht wegscrollst, sondern screenshottest und zerlegst. Du Bock hast, dass deine Arbeit an echten Zahlen gemessen wird. Du schnell iterierst und aus jedem Test etwas mitnimmst. Du den Ehrgeiz hast, zu den Besten in deinem Fach zu gehören. Du mit einem preisgekrönten Design & Motion Team wachsen möchtest. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit E-Commerce Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle, Supplements). Grundkenntnisse in After Effects, um Statics leicht zu animieren. Erfahrung mit Creative Strategy, Ad-Library-Research oder Creative Testing. Erfahrung mit Landingpage- oder Shopify-Design. Warum wir? Ein starkes Grafik-Team, das eng mit Motion, Video und Performance zusammenarbeitet. Du siehst, was deine Creatives bewirken. Echte Zahlen statt Bauchgefühl. Motiviertes High-Performance-Team: keine Politik, flache Hierarchien, getragen von deiner Eigeninitiative. Spannende Leadgen- und E-Commerce-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle). Fettes und steuerfreies Benefitpaket inkl. Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen, Deutschlandticket. Modernes, zentrales Office im Herzen Münchens (Gärtnerplatz), der Ankerpunkt unserer Zusammenarbeit und Kultur. Team-Events, Workshops, Weiterbildungen. Darauf schauen wir Schick uns ein kurzes Anschreiben, so knapp wie möglich. Drei klare Benefits, warum es sich lohnt, mit dir zu arbeiten, reichen völlig. Dazu dein Portfolio mit mindestens 5 Ads, die wirklich live waren. Deine Challenge: Wir erwarten, dass du unsere Ausschreibung bis ins Detail liest. Die Bewerbung ist deshalb schon ein kleiner Test. Füge das Bild einer Zitrone in dein Anschreiben, deinen Lebenslauf oder deine Bewerbungsmail ein. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Rezeptmanagement (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>Deine Rolle</strong></h2> <p>Als Werkstudent/in im Rezeptmanagement unterstützt du unser Rezeptentwicklungsteam bei der Pflege und Verwaltung kulinarischer Daten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Culinary-Operations-Team zusammen und sorgst mit einem guten Blick fürs Detail, Struktur und Sorgfalt dafür, dass Rezepturen korrekt abgebildet und unsere Datensätze zuverlässig gepflegt sind.</p> <p>Bitte beachte, dass diese Stelle zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet ist.</p> <h2><strong>Dein Verantwortungsbereich</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Rezept-Management: </strong>Pflege und Aktualisierung von Rezeptdaten in unseren internen Systemen sowie kurzfristige Anpassung von Rezepten bei Änderungen von Zutaten</li> <li><strong>Korrekturlesen:</strong> Prüfung von Rezepten auf korrekte Datenpunkte, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz</li> <li><strong>Rezept-Optimierung:</strong> Erstellung und Überprüfung anpassbarer Rezeptvarianten auf Basis bestehender Rezepte</li> <li><strong>Datenkontrolle:</strong> Regelmäßige Validierung der Einträge in unserem System sowie systematische Fehleranalyse und -behebung</li> <li><strong>Performance-Analyse: </strong>Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Rezepten auf Basis von Kundenfeedback sowie Zusammenfassung neuer Erkenntnisse und wiederkehrender Muster</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Profil&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Studium mit Bezug zu Ernährung, Daten, Naturwissenschaften oder Wirtschaft</li> <li>Begeisterung für die Themen Essen und Kochen sowie grundlegendes kulinarisches Verständnis (z. B. Garzeiten, Geschmacksprofile, Zutatenkunde), welches eine fachliche Beurteilung bzw. Bearbeitung von Rezepten ermöglicht - auch ohne selbst am Herd zu stehen</li> <li>Detailverliebtheit, Zuverlässigkeit und ein selbstständiger Arbeitsstil, kombiniert mit Freude an klaren Strukturen und sorgfältiger Datenpflege</li> <li>Lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit, logisch nachvollziehbare Alternativen selbstständig zu entwickeln</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. auf C1-Niveau)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bieten wir Dir</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz </strong>mit einem tollen Team&nbsp;in Berlin-Kreuzberg</li> <li><strong>Rabatte</strong> auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen und Convini-Produkte</li> <li><strong>Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten</strong> durch interne Trainings sowie ein jährliches Team-Budget für Weiterbildung <strong>&nbsp;(NICHT FÜR PRAKTIKANTEN)</strong></li> <li><strong>Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld</strong> mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit &amp; Work From Home/Work From Abroad Policy&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Ein umfassendes Onboarding</strong> inkl. Buddy-Programm</li> <li><strong>Spaß</strong> bei Teamevents, Friday Beers, Company Runs, Buchclub u.v.m.</li> <li><strong>Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote</strong> bei Urban Sports Club bzw. John Reed, regelmäßige Yoga-Sessions</li> <li><strong>Initiativen für das Wohlbefinden</strong> durch Kooperationen mit der Headspace-App und Spill</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Einen monatlichen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bist du die fehlende Zutat?</strong></h2> <p class="p1">Wenn diese Gelegenheit für Dich lecker klingt, freuen wir uns darauf, von Dir zu hören. Consultative and outcome-focused sales skills: demonstrated ability to diagnose business needs, tailor solutions and influence decision-making with impact. Remote-ready communication & autonomy: excellent verbal and written communicator, strong listener, adept at building rapport and driving processes without day-to-day supervision. Resilience & growth mindset: high level of self-motivation, curiosity to learn continuously and openness to feedback and coaching. raw.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

 

Your impact

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch.

This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. The role is also more technical than it might first appear: you'll get close to the real world edge cases and issues that surface once a solution meets implementation reality, giving you hands on technical exposure without needing a payments or engineering background going in.

Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase for its biggest deals. You'll report to Jan-Jaap van Helden.

 

What you'll ship

  • Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live

  • Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track

  • Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface

  • Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned

  • Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue

  • Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

     

What you'll bring

  • Up to 3 years of experience in ecommerce or payments, in a similar role

  • Fluent in German and English, since this role supports the German market and works directly with local merchants

  • Strong organisational and structuring skills, with solid project management ability

  • Genuine technical interest and the ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, since this role gets close to the edge cases that surface once a solution meets reality

  • An ownership mindset, taking charge of the implementation process rather than reacting to it, while staying flexible within agreed roles and processes

  • Honest, open communication style with a genuine, trustworthy manner, including a strong track record collaborating with pre-sales teams and handling conflict at handover

  • Payments or ecommerce experience, or familiarity with the ecosystem, is a strong plus though not required

 

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Operativer Einkauf
description: Wer wir sind: Wir entwickeln die Intelligenz, die es Robotern ermöglicht, die reale Welt wahrzunehmen, zu verstehen und in ihr zu handeln – über das Labor hinaus und hinein in den industriellen Alltag, etwa in Lagerhallen und Fabriken. Unsere Technologie schließt die Automatisierungslücken, an denen klassische Systeme scheitern. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Art und Weise, wie körperliche Arbeit verrichtet wird, neu zu denken, und suchen neugierige, mutige Köpfe, die die Zukunft der Robotik gemeinsam mit uns gestalten wollen. Überblick: Wir suchen eine prozessorientierte Person, die im operativen technischen Einkauf, das kaufmännische Fundament unserer innovativen Robotiklösungen bei Sereact stärkt. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere internen kaufmännischen Abläufe und bist ein echtes Organisationstalent, das sich gerne mitten ins Geschehen stürzt und dafür sorgt, dass unser Tagesgeschäft im Hintergrund reibungslos läuft. Die Stelle ist in Stuttgart angesiedelt und eignet sich ideal für jemanden, der gerne strukturierte Prozesse aufbaut, kaufmännische Aufgaben steuert und ein Team unterstützt, das an modernster Technologie arbeitet. Deine Aufgaben: Projekt- und Auftragsmanagement: Du steuerst unsere Projekte aus kaufmännischer Sicht, von der ersten Bestellung bis zur finalen Lieferung. Einkauf und Materialwirtschaft: Du unterstützt die Beschaffung von Komponenten und pflegst enge Beziehungen zu unseren Lieferanten. Bestandsmanagement: Du behältst unsere Lagerbestände im Blick und stellst sicher, dass alle Komponenten zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind. Allgemeine Administration: Von der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung bis zur Stammdatenpflege sorgst du dafür, dass unser Tagesgeschäft reibungslos läuft. Qualifikationen: Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Industriekaufmann/zur Industriekauffrau oder ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre. Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer kaufmännischen oder operativen Rolle. Mindset: Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Keine Aufgabe ist dir zu klein oder zu komplex, wenn das Team Unterstützung braucht. Antrieb: Deine Motivation und Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als tiefgehendes Branchenwissen in der Robotik. Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, idealerweise Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Unser Interviewprozess: Bewerbung Cultural-Fit-Interview (40 Min.): Ein Gespräch darüber, wie du arbeitest, was dich motiviert und wonach du suchst. Es erwarten dich Fragen zu deinem Lebenslauf, deinem „Warum" und Zeit für deine eigenen Fragen. Fachliches Interview (45 Min.): Ein tieferer Einblick in deine Fähigkeiten und deinen Problemlösungsansatz für diese Rolle. Gespräch mit den Gründern: Du triffst einen unserer Gründer, um über die Rolle und deinen Werdegang zu sprechen. Eine gute Gelegenheit, mehr über die Vision von Sereact zu erfahren, Fragen zu stellen und ein klares Gefühl für unsere Unternehmenskultur und Arbeitsumgebung zu bekommen. Was wir bieten: Wellpass (Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft) Flexible Arbeitszeiten Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice bei Bedarf Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktive Vergütung und hervorragende Karrieremöglichkeiten Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Elektroniker (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Embodied AI, das die menschliche Arbeitswelt revolutioniert. Mit modernster Robotik und fortschrittlicher künstlicher Intelligenz entwickeln wir transformative Technologien, die neu definieren, wie Arbeit über verschiedenste Branchen hinweg erledigt wird — und ermöglichen es Unternehmen, Abläufe zu optimieren, die Produktivität zu steigern und neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen. Überblick Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Elektriker, der die elektrische Verkabelung und Steuerungssysteme unserer autonomen Robotersysteme installiert, verkabelt und in Stand hält. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem Mechanical- und Hardware-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle elektrischen Komponenten zuverlässig funktionieren und nahtlos in die Gesamtsysteme integriert sind. Deine Aufgaben Elektrokonstruktion und Planung: Elektrokonstruktion gemäß geltenden Richtlinien und Normen. Erstellung von Schaltplänen für unsere Robotersysteme. Installation und Verkabelung: Verkabelung und Installation elektrischer Komponenten und Steuerungssysteme in unseren Robotersystemen. Montage von Schaltschränken, Steckverbindern und Sensorik nach technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen. Verlegung und Anschluss von Kabeln unter Einhaltung geltender Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards. Test, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung: Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Systeme vor Auslieferung und Installation beim Kunden. Diagnose und Behebung elektrischer Störungen während der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und im laufenden Betrieb. Durchführung regelmäßiger Wartungs- und Sicherheitsprüfungen an bestehenden Systemen. Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit den Mechanical- und Software-Teams zur Integration elektronischer Komponenten in die physische Struktur der Roboter. Unterstützung bei Vor-Ort-Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen beim Kunden. Reisebereitschaft ~50% Qualifikationen & Anforderungen Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker, Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen sowie Kenntnisse in Verkabelung, Verdrahtung und Anschlusstechnik. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten (z. B. Multimeter, Oszilloskop). Kenntnisse relevanter elektrischer Sicherheitsnormen und -vorschriften. Erfahrung in der Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder im Maschinenbau von Vorteil. Selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit. title: Chief of Staff to the Co-CEO - m/f/d
description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role Judith Dada is Co-CEO of Langdock alongside Lennard. She is also Senior Partner at Visionaries Club, serves on the board of Personio, co-founded Relativity Collective, a programme for Europe’s student founders, and writes about AI, creativity, Europe and human flourishing as Dadalogue. She co-authored Europa 2031 . What connects all of it is a conviction that technological progress, done well, is how we build a better Europe and a better world. As Chief of Staff, you will be Judith’s right hand across everything she does. Your job is to extend her reach and impact across Langdock, Europe’s AI ecosystem and beyond. You will structure and execute across a wide surface area, and create the conditions in which Judith does her best work. You will work with her every day, so expect the steepest learning curve of your career. Langdock’s product is expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do, with chat, agents, meetings, code and apps; and down the stack into our own compute and inference. You will help Judith stay close to the most important work across this growing product surface and the company. What You Will Do Run meticulous project management. You will hold the threads across dozens of topics and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You work half a step ahead, spot bottlenecks before they happen and follow through. You act as an honest broker: synthesising and pressure-testing plans to bring them to their full potential. Augment Judith’s execution at Langdock. You will keep Judith close to the most important work across a fast-growing product surface. You will prepare her for key decisions, make sure things happen afterwards and support strategic workstreams. Produce Judith’s ideas. You will structure and challenge Judith’s thinking to draw out the idea worth making, then shape it into a keynote, essay, video, panel, interview or key event. You will help turn customer insights and research into thought leadership that shapes how European leaders think about AI. AI is already an exceptionally capable research assistant; your value lies in depth, taste and operational structure. You do not ghostwrite. You sharpen the thinking and run the flow from first idea to finished piece. Scale executive engagement. Together with Marketing, you will design exceptional rooms and experiences that bring Europe’s key AI decision-makers together. You will work with our go-to-market teams so Judith’s external work serves the needs of a customer base that is growing quickly. Extend Judith’s reach into policy and the European AI ecosystem. You will prepare and follow through on policy work and ecosystem initiatives, helping Judith contribute to the conversations shaping AI in Europe. What Makes This Different You will work at the forefront of one of the most consequential technological shifts in history. Langdock has grown to around $50M ARR and more than 13,000 customers while remaining profitable and independent of outside investment. You will join at a moment when our product is expanding quickly and Europe needs AI companies built from Europe for the world. Judith is Co-CEO of Langdock, Senior Partner at Visionaries Club and active across the European AI ecosystem. This role gives you a front-row seat across that breadth of work, with direct responsibility for helping turn ideas and decisions into action. This is a tour of duty. We ask for a commitment of at least two years, with the explicit prospect of shaping a longer-term role together once we know where you shine. The scope is broad, the feedback loops are short and the learning curve is steep. You Might Be a Fit If… You have a few years of experience in consulting, investing or a startup that grew quickly. You know how to structure chaos and are still incredibly hungry to learn. You have a deep fascination with technology and AI, and a real belief that technological progress can build a better world. You have impeccable taste. You know what good looks like in a sentence, a slide, an event and an argument, and you can act with confidence in Judith’s stead. You have range and depth. You can switch context many times a day and still go deep when it counts. You write clearly and speak well in the room, in both German and English. You bring calm and good judgement. You know what matters and what can wait, read people well, and hold them accountable with kindness. You see problems and fix them without being asked, and stay persistent until they are done. You are discreet and trustworthy, because you will see everything. You have an exceptional work ethic and are comfortable with a highly demanding role that includes some travel. The Environment You will sit with Judith in our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all 65 of us work together in person. Judith has a dedicated Executive Assistant for calendar, travel and admin. You will work closely with them and with Lennard’s Chief of Staff on day-to-day matters. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense. Next steps We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week. That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works. You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win. — Grigory Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it. Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months. We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market. This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more. What you'll actually do in the first 3 months This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes: Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions. Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI. Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews. What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months? After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run. You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game. Here's what you'll be close to in the next months: Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it. Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20. Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next manager. AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff. What success looks like At 6 months: The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality. At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've found and/or coached the EM Nr. 2 to support growth. How we work We've written in depth about our engineering culture. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution. AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here . Zero-bugs. We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product. We build what customers need , not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us. You know what it feels like when there's no playbook Able to work in European timezone (CET/CEST). EMEA-based, ideally Germany or UK Nice to have You've grown a team to 15+ at a VC-funded startup Managed tech leads or a second manager Previous experience at a fully remote company Interview process We want to see how you think, build, and lead — not test you on algorithms. Here's the process: 30 min — Intro call with our talent team 45 min — Interview with Grigory 45 min — Technical interview 1.5 hr — AI-assisted build session: system design for a real feature, then building part of it with AI 2 hr — Leadership session with the founders Then you’ll get the offer! title: Senior Product Designer
description: Senior Product Designer @ Secfix Location: Remote (EMEA) · CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. How do you feel about owning a feature from the first customer conversation to the version that's live in production — writing the spec yourself, pairing closely with engineers through the build, and overseeing your design shipped in production exactly the way you designed it? If that sounds like the right shape of the job — designer who owns, not designer who hands off — read on. I've spent most of my career believing the best designers aren't the ones with the prettiest Figma files. They're the ones who can frame a problem, write a spec, sit with engineers through the build, and own that what shipped is what they designed. Our founding product designer, Ghada , has been doing exactly that since we started. The engineering team has doubled, and we're shipping faster than we ever have. We're hiring the third designer because there's more good work to do than two people can handle — and we'd rather ship faster than slow down. Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it. Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months. We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to European market leadership. This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of product design work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more. What we believe Compliance software has historically been built like the audit it automates — heavy, defensive, ugly. We're building something else. The customer is a real person trying to ship audit-ready evidence on a Friday afternoon. The product should respect their time, automate the boring parts, and make the rest feel calm. Quality is the product. Most of our category competes on feature lists. We compete on craft. A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work. What the role is We expect strong design skills, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. You work in a small team — usually with one or two engineers — and pair closely from the first prototype through to production. You own the project from beginning to end. Alongside the features you ship, you do three things that make everyone else faster: Maintain the components and patterns that make design fast. Own how the team ships. We have no PMs. You write the specs, run the ticketing workflow, keep engineers unblocked. Build the tools and skills — Cursor rules, design QA skills, prompt templates — that let engineers do good design work without you in the room. The leverage is doing all four well. Doing only one is the wrong shape. How we work No PMs. Designers and engineers run product. You talk to customers, frame the problem, write the spec, decide what ships. Small temporary teams. You plus one or two engineers per project. Whoever is closest to the problem leads. Design leads the logic; engineering tests feasibility. You bring the V1. Engineers push back on what's expensive or risky, and start ahead with system design. They help spot edge cases. You adjust it fast. We get from v1 to v4 in a matter of hours or a few days. Prototype-grade, not wireframes. Real components, real states, real copy. Sometimes an LLM-built prototype before Figma. The component library stays current because the speed of design depends on it. Handoff is the beginning, not the end. You're in the engineering channel. You review the PR. You verify on production. Staging QA is the first gate, not the last. In-sync culture with a thoughtful comms mindset. Loom for reviews, Notion for specs, quick loops in Gather where written comms don’t cut it, all happening in the same time zone. Teammates are reviewing things quickly. Engineers and designers spend under two hours in weekly meetings. AI is part of the craft. We use Claude to pressure-test ideas, draft specs, surface edge cases, and write test cases. Not to skip thinking. The first three months Month 1. Ship your first design to production. Get into the codebase, the customer language, the way we write specs. Sit on customer calls. Month 2. Own a full feature end-to-end. Customer conversations, problem framing, Figma, spec, engineer pairing, PR review, production verification. Month 3 and beyond. Push the design system forward. Start building the tools and skills that make engineers faster at design. Improve the product design process. The bar is yours to defend. Who you are 8+ years designing B2B SaaS desktop applications as Staff/Principal Product Designer or similar. Dense interfaces — tables, filters, permissions, settings pages. You've been the only designer, or one of two or three, in companies under 50 people at least once before. You know how to set the bar without a design org behind you. Your portfolio is "I," not "we." You can name the engineer you paired with on each feature, the design decision you defended through the build, and what happened when the feature reached users. You communicate clearly and concisely in English: in Slack, in docs and on a call. You're fast in Figma with or without AI. You’re already in a serious relationship with LLMs. You treat engineering feasibility as input, not a constraint. When an engineer says "three weeks, here's why," you find the version that's 80% as good and ships next week. You're comfortable doing product work without the PM title. You hear feedback and come back the next day with something better. You don't spend the hour in between defending the version that's already outdated. Compensation Salary + equity based on experience. The offered compensation depends on the individual's qualifications assessed during the interview process. What we offer Generous equity. Everyone is an owner. 26 days holiday + local public holidays. Comprehensive health insurance. €1,000 annual personal development budget. Remote workspace and co-working budget. Latest equipment. Team summits 1-2x per year. Recent ones: Alicante, Costa Brava, Austrian Alps, Milan. Local hubs in Munich, Berlin, London. Visa support if you want to relocate. Interview process We aim to invite you to a first conversation within a week and give feedback after every stage. Intro call with talent team (~45 min) Portfolio conversation with product designer (~45 min) Collaborative design task (compensated, a couple of hours over the span of 2-3 days) Final interview with Grigory (~60 min) Order may flex depending on availability. If you make it to the exercise and don't get an offer, we'll tell you specifically what got in the way. Learn how we think and work How we designed remote culture at Secfix Thoughtful communication at Secfix Building production-grade product with AI in 2026 Building what customers need, not what they ask for Our zero-bug policy Crafting quality that endures — Karri Saarinen's Config talk We are an equal-opportunity employer and a remote-only company. We hire within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and don't support fully asynchronous work. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work.

What the role is

We expect strong design skills, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. You work in a small team — usually with one or two engineers — and pair closely from the first prototype through to production. You own the project from beginning to end.

Alongside the features you ship, you do three things that make everyone else faster:

  • Maintain the components and patterns that make design fast.

  • Own how the team ships. We have no PMs. You write the specs, run the ticketing workflow, keep engineers unblocked.

  • Build the tools and skills — Cursor rules, design QA skills, prompt templates — that let engineers do good design work without you in the room.

The leverage is doing all four well. Doing only one is the wrong shape.

How we work

  • No PMs. Designers and engineers run product. You talk to customers, frame the problem, write the spec, decide what ships.

  • Small temporary teams. You plus one or two engineers per project. Whoever is closest to the problem leads.

  • Design leads the logic; engineering tests feasibility. You bring the V1. Engineers push back on what's expensive or risky, and start ahead with system design. They help spot edge cases. You adjust it fast. We get from v1 to v4 in a matter of hours or a few days.

  • Prototype-grade, not wireframes. Real components, real states, real copy. Sometimes an LLM-built prototype before Figma. The component library stays current because the speed of design depends on it.

  • Handoff is the beginning, not the end. You're in the engineering channel. You review the PR. You verify on production. Staging QA is the first gate, not the last.

  • In-sync culture with a thoughtful comms mindset. Loom for reviews, Notion for specs, quick loops in Gather where written comms don’t cut it, all happening in the same time zone. Teammates are reviewing things quickly. Engineers and designers spend under two hours in weekly meetings.

  • AI is part of the craft. We use Claude to pressure-test ideas, draft specs, surface edge cases, and write test cases. Not to skip thinking.

The first three months

  • Month 1. Ship your first design to production. Get into the codebase, the customer language, the way we write specs. Sit on customer calls.

  • Month 2. Own a full feature end-to-end. Customer conversations, problem framing, Figma, spec, engineer pairing, PR review, production verification.

  • Month 3 and beyond. Push the design system forward. Start building the tools and skills that make engineers faster at design. Improve the product design process. The bar is yours to defend.

Who you are

  • 8+ years designing B2B SaaS desktop applications as Staff/Principal Product Designer or similar. Dense interfaces — tables, filters, permissions, settings pages.

  • You've been the only designer, or one of two or three, in companies under 50 people at least once before. You know how to set the bar without a design org behind you.

  • Your portfolio is "I," not "we." You can name the engineer you paired with on each feature, the design decision you defended through the build, and what happened when the feature reached users.

  • You communicate clearly and concisely in English: in Slack, in docs and on a call.

  • You're fast in Figma with or without AI. You’re already in a serious relationship with LLMs.

  • You treat engineering feasibility as input, not a constraint. When an engineer says "three weeks, here's why," you find the version that's 80% as good and ships next week.

  • You're comfortable doing product work without the PM title.

  • You hear feedback and come back the next day with something better. You don't spend the hour in between defending the version that's already outdated.

Compensation

Salary + equity based on experience. The offered compensation depends on the individual's qualifications assessed during the interview process.

What we offer

  • Generous equity. Everyone is an owner.

  • 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Comprehensive health insurance.

  • €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Remote workspace and co-working budget.

  • Latest equipment.

  • Team summits 1-2x per year. Recent ones: Alicante, Costa Brava, Austrian Alps, Milan.

  • Local hubs in Munich, Berlin, London. Visa support if you want to relocate.

Interview process

We aim to invite you to a first conversation within a week and give feedback after every stage.

  • Intro call with talent team (~45 min)

  • Portfolio conversation with product designer (~45 min)

  • Collaborative design task (compensated, a couple of hours over the span of 2-3 days)

  • Final interview with Grigory (~60 min)

Order may flex depending on availability. If you make it to the exercise and don't get an offer, we'll tell you specifically what got in the way.

Learn how we think and work

  • How we designed remote culture at Secfix

  • Thoughtful communication at Secfix

  • Building production-grade product with AI in 2026

  • Building what customers need, not what they ask for

  • Our zero-bug policy

  • Crafting quality that endures — Karri Saarinen's Config talk

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Venture Lead (Berlin)

Salary range: €140,000-180,000/annum

We’re looking for a Venture Lead who will act as a seasoned architect of our growth, owning the journey from initial insight to global scale for our next generation of products. In this role, you will build the "machine" that launches "Unicorn-level" ventures, setting the strategic foundation for massive market expansions and new business lines like Cashback.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Incubate & Launch Ventures: Transform validated opportunities into "Unicorn-level" market pilots, securing signed lighthouse clients and executive-approved business models.

  • Establish Venture Operating Models: Architect the governance, funding, and decision frameworks that empower R&D squads to ship milestones autonomously without executive escalations.

  • Forge Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and integrate flagship advertiser partnerships into the core product experience to elevate Almedia's global market positioning.

  • Scale High-Performance Teams: Build a world-class venture organization by hiring and mentoring key leaders, setting extreme quality bars, and coaching managers to deliver outcomes independently.

  • Drive P&L & Playbook Excellence: Take full ownership of venture business impact by running recurring data reviews and codifying playbooks that prioritize our highest-leverage bets.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Venture Building Track Record: Proven experience owning a multi-venture thesis in a hyper-growth environment, with a history of making disciplined scale/kill decisions.

  • Operational Architecture Mastery: Expertise in building high-velocity delivery engines that translate high-level strategy into weekly execution plans using Lean Startup and Design Thinking.

  • AdTech & Growth Fluency: Deep understanding of architecting analytics systems (LTV/CAC, retention, incrementality) while ensuring privacy and compliance readiness.

  • Enterprise Leadership: Experience negotiating complex commercial terms and representing the company effectively with clients, investors, and stakeholders.

  • Bonus: Success in launching or scaling a major product in the Rewarded User Acquisition or Fintech landscape.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: You model extreme ownership and initiative, taking full accountability for the venture P&L and ROI from initial concept to global scale.

  • Raise the Bar: You are a natural problem-solver who standardizes excellence through playbooks, removing blockers hands-on to elevate the entire organization's standards.

  • Move Fast: You thrive on the intensity of the build, making fast, evidence-based decisions at high velocity to maximize venture value and speed-to-impact.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €140K – €180K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide.</p> <p>We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.</p> <h2><strong>💡 Why Subscriptions?&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship.</li> <li>Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.</li> <li>Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo,&nbsp; DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity.</li> <li>A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously.</li> </ul> <h2>🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here</h2> <p>We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. Bringing genuine research depth and being comfortable with exploring ambiguous, early-stage problems, you will also be hands-on enough in design to turn what you learn directly into work that ships.</p> <p><strong>You will be responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Foundational Generative Research: </strong>Heading up exploratory research to build a deep, evidence-based understanding of learners, their needs, behaviours, and unmet problems in ambiguous, early-stage problem spaces, setting up continuous discovery practices.</li> <li><strong>Methodological Rigour &amp; Infrastructure: </strong>Applying structured research methodology, study design, sampling strategies, and bias mitigation, whilst building a robust research repository and knowledge base to compound insight over time.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Insight Sharing: </strong>Sharing generative insights clearly with Product Management, UX Design, and Growth Marketing to shape decisions, product directions, and commercial conversations and positioning.</li> <li><strong>Design Delivery: </strong>As a small, start-up style team, dedicating roughly 30% of your capacity to translating research insights directly into simple, elegant, production-ready, and highly accessible user experience design solutions.</li> <li><strong>Team Collaboration &amp; Growth: </strong>Working closely with the Lead UX Designer to manage and balance capacity, mentoring colleagues to raise research maturity across the Learning Experience team.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>👥 Meet the team</strong></h3> <p>You'll report directly into our Chief Product Officer (CPO). Mentorship: </strong>Passionate about sharing knowledge, mentoring peers to raise research maturity, and providing direct, empathetic feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice to have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-Driven Experiences: </strong>Familiarity researching and designing for AI-mediated interactions, including balancing AI visibility, user control, and trust-building.</li> <li><strong>AI Tool Integration: </strong>Intentional and effective use of AI tools in your own practice for synthesis, prototyping, or exploring directions faster.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>💰Salary and benefits:</strong></h3> <p>💸£69,000 - £81,000 dependent upon experience</p> <p>🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)</p> <p>🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas</p> <p>💰 EMI Share Options Scheme</p> <p>🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance</p> <p>⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best</p> <p>💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space</p> <p>🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking</p> <p>🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance</p> <p>🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)</p> <p>🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)</p> <p>💸 6% employer pension contribution</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>📍Location:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. If you are more than 50 miles away from the office, we offer full remote working support, with the opportunity to join colleagues for in-person collaboration several times a year.</p> <p>We will discuss ways of working with you at interview however if you have any questions before you apply please reach out to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
